source:
hostname SEED-HOST
username SEED-USER secret 9 SEED-HASH
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 ip address 192.0.2.10 255.255.255.0

set deviceconfig system hostname SEED-HOST
set mgt-config users SEED-USER phash SEED-HASH
set network ike gateway SEED-GATEWAY authentication pre-shared-key key SEED-PSK
set shared address SEED-OBJECT ip-netmask 192.0.2.10/24
set rulebase security rules SEED-RULE source [ SEED-OBJECT ]
set deviceconfig system snmp-setting access-setting version v2c snmp-community SEED-COMMUNITY

set system host-name SEED-HOST
set system login user SEED-USER full-name "SEED-PERSON"
set system login user SEED-USER authentication encrypted-password "SEED-HASH"
set system login user SEED-USER authentication ssh-ed25519 "ssh-ed25519 SEED-SSH"
set system radius-server 192.0.2.20 secret "SEED-RADIUS"
set snmp community SEED-COMMUNITY authorization read-only
set security ike policy SEED-POLICY pre-shared-key ascii-text "SEED-PSK"
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 192.0.2.10/24

hostname SEED-HOST
username SEED-USER password 9 SEED-HASH privilege 15
snmp-server community SEED-COMMUNITY ro
radius server auth 192.0.2.20
 key 7 SEED-RADIUS
!
interface ethernet 1/1/1
 description SEED-DESCRIPTION
 ip address 192.0.2.10/24

hostname SEED-HOST
username SEED-USER sha256-password 9 SEED-HASH privilege 15
snmp-server community SEED-COMMUNITY ro
radius server auth 192.0.2.20
 key 7 SEED-RADIUS
!
interface ethernet 1/1/1
 description SEED-DESCRIPTION
 ip address 192.0.2.10/24
